title: grossularia × innominata
intro: Grossularia × innominata, commonly known as the hybrid gooseberry, is a plant species that combines the characteristics of both gooseberry (Ribes uva-crispa) and black currant (Ribes nigrum) to produce a unique fruit-bearing shrub. The health benefits of Grossularia × innominata include its high antioxidant content, which helps to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Grossularia × innominata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
